plan: Land at Krabi airport and take a taxi or minibus 40 minutes to Ao Nang and the Centara Ao Nang Beach Resort. Easy evening stroll on Ao Nang beach and the promenade, no swim.
romantic: Sunset from Ao Nang beach, then dinner at a seafront restaurant.

plan: White-water rafting on the Song Phraek river in Phang Nga: hotel pickup, about 1.5 hours by road, then the 5 km course of Class II-III rapids with an optional 30-minute ATV ride at the camp. Rafting is the only time in the water this day and counts as an activity, so no swim or beach time.
romantic: Quiet dinner at a rooftop restaurant in Ao Nang, back and dry.

plan: Morning Thai cooking class with a market visit near Ao Nang, then Wat Kaew Korawaram and the Krabi Town riverside. Evening at the Ao Nang Landmark night market. No swim.
romantic: A couples Thai massage in the afternoon, then a sunset walk on the Ao Nang promenade.

plan: Private longtail boat from Ao Nang to Railay for sightseeing only: stay dry, walk the Railay East boardwalk and climb to the Railay viewpoint. Beach walk at Phra Nang for the views, no swim.
romantic: Sunset longtail ride back along the limestone cliffs, with no swim.

plan: Swims allowed from today. Speedboat day to the Hong Islands with kayaking in the lagoon, snorkelling stops and a swim off the beach, with lunch included.
romantic: A picnic with a swim at Hong Island beach, then a beachfront dinner at Ao Nang.

plan: Morning flight from Krabi to Bangkok (about 1 hour 20 minutes) and check in at Hilton Garden Inn Bangkok Riverside. Late-afternoon go-karting at Topkart Bangkok near Chidlom.
romantic: Watch the city lights come on from the glass floor of Mahanakhon SkyWalk.

plan: Grand Palace and the Emerald Buddha at the 8:30 opening, then the Reclining Buddha at Wat Pho, a short walk away. Rest in the afternoon, then an early dinner and the countdown on the riverfront beside ICONSIAM, Bangkok’s main New Year spot.
romantic: Midnight fireworks over the Chao Phraya, watched from the ICONSIAM riverside terrace.

plan: Slow New Year’s morning. Afternoon at ICONSIAM next door and its SookSiam indoor market, then an evening street-food walk on Yaowarat in Chinatown.
romantic: A tuk-tuk ride together under the neon signs of Yaowarat Road to close the trip.

plan: Land in Ho Chi Minh City and take a private car to Mui Ne on the expressway (about three to four hours). Check in at Pandanus Resort and take an easy walk on the beach and the resort gardens (no swim).
romantic: Christmas seafood dinner at a candlelit table on the Mui Ne beach road.

plan: Sunrise jeep tour to the White Sand Dunes with a quad-bike ride, then the fishing village and the ankle-deep Fairy Stream walk (wading only, no swim). Rest at the resort in the afternoon.
romantic: Sandboard down the Red Sand Dunes, then watch the sunset together from the top.

plan: Morning at the Po Sah Inu Cham Towers, then a local cooking class with a market visit. Beach walk only, no swim.
romantic: Couples massage at a Mui Ne spa.

plan: Take a shared limousine van back to Ho Chi Minh City (about four hours) and check in at Silverland Sakyo. In the evening, the XO Foodie Tour by motorbike picks you up at the hotel.
romantic: Nightcap at the Saigon Saigon Rooftop Bar at the Caravelle, a short walk from the hotel.

plan: Morning at the Independence Palace and the War Remnants Museum. In the afternoon, race go-karts at TGC Speedway in The Global City (about 25 minutes away), with a two-seat kart option. Swim in the hotel pool before dinner.
romantic: Riverside dinner on the wooden deck of The Deck Saigon in Thao Dien, ten minutes from the track.

plan: Photo stop at the pink Tan Dinh Church, then the view from Landmark 81 SkyView, the tallest building in Vietnam. Slow afternoon with a swim in the hotel pool.
romantic: Saigon Princess dinner cruise on the Saigon River.

plan: Slow morning to rest for the late night. AO Show bamboo circus at the Saigon Opera House at 18:00, then an early dinner nearby.
romantic: Countdown on Nguyen Hue Walking Street, with midnight fireworks over the street and the river.

plan: New Year’s Day shopping at Saigon Centre and Takashimaya, then the Central Post Office and the Dong Khoi boutiques. Airport transfer for the flight home on 2 Jan.
romantic: Coffee together in a book café on Nguyen Van Binh Book Street, beside the Post Office.

plan: Land in Kuala Lumpur and take the 1-hour flight to Langkawi. Check in at the Mercure Pantai Cenang, then walk Pantai Cenang beach at sunset (no swim).
romantic: Late Christmas dinner at a beachfront restaurant on Pantai Cenang, watching the sun go down over the sand.

plan: SkyCab cable car and the Sky Bridge at the 9:30 opening, using the SkyGlide lift instead of the forest trail. Late-afternoon go-karting on the 1.3 km track at Morac Adventure Park near the airport.
romantic: Watch the evening fire show from beanbags at Kalut Cafe and Bar on Pantai Cenang, a few minutes from the hotel.

plan: Paint your own batik piece at Atma Alam Batik Art Village in Padang Matsirat, about 15 minutes away. At 5 pm board the Crystal Yacht sunset cruise (no swim, stay on deck).
romantic: Barbecue buffet dinner on deck as the sun sets over the Andaman Sea.

plan: Underwater World Langkawi aquarium on Pantai Cenang, then drive to the Telaga Tujuh waterfalls viewpoint (look only, no swim). Walk the sand at Tanjung Rhu in the late afternoon (no swim).
romantic: Couples massage at a spa on Pantai Cenang, then sunset at Tanjung Rhu beach.

plan: Fly to Kuala Lumpur, about 1 hour. Swim in the Traders Hotel pool, now that the no-swim days are over. Free traditional dance show at the Malaysia Tourism Centre (MaTiC) on Jalan Ampang at 3 pm, then dinner at the Jalan Alor food street.
romantic: Sunset drinks at SkyBar, the pool bar atop Traders Hotel facing the Petronas Towers.

plan: Half-day white-water rafting on the Selangor River at Kuala Kubu Bharu, about 1 hour away by car, with lunch. The rapids are grade 2 to 4, and a guide steers each raft.
romantic: Evening walk in KLCC Park to watch the Lake Symphony fountain show at 8, 9 or 10 pm.

plan: LaZat Malaysian cooking class with a wet-market tour in Taman Tun Dr Ismail, from 8:30 to about 13:30, roughly 25 minutes away. Rest at the hotel pool in the afternoon.
romantic: New Year’s Eve countdown and fireworks over the Petronas Towers at the KLCC Park Esplanade, a short walk from the hotel.

plan: Late start. Merdeka Square and the Sultan Abdul Samad Building, 15 minutes by car, then Aquaria KLCC, a short walk from the hotel. Evening Petronas Towers Skybridge and Observation Deck. Airport transfer for the flight home on 2 Jan.
romantic: Sunset from the Petronas Observation Deck, then a last stroll through KLCC Park.

plan: Fly Manila to Busuanga, then a van to Coron town and check in at Asia Grand View Hotel. Easy evening walk along the Coron waterfront (no swim) and a seafood Christmas dinner overlooking the bay.
romantic: Christmas dinner at a waterfront seafood restaurant, with the lights of Coron Bay.

plan: Early climb up Mount Tapyas (about 720 steps) for the view over Coron Bay, then the public market and a paluto lunch, where you pick seafood at the market and have it cooked nearby. Afternoon rest, then a sunset stroll on the Coron waterfront (no swim).
romantic: Sunset from the cross at the top of Mount Tapyas.

plan: Full-day Calauit Safari tour: the giraffes, zebras and Calauit wildlife preserve by boat and van, with lunch. Land and boat sightseeing only, no swim.
romantic: Candlelit dinner at a rooftop restaurant in Coron town.

plan: Morning fast ferry from Coron to El Nido, then a van to Cadlao Resort. Late-afternoon walk on Lio Beach and Kalye Artisano (beach walk only, no swim).
romantic: An evening stroll through Kalye Artisano in the Lio estate to pick a handmade keepsake for each other.

plan: Island Tour A by shared boat: kayak the Big Lagoon and Small Lagoon, then swim and snorkel at Seven Commandos Beach. Swimming is fine from today.
romantic: Lunch on the boat on a quiet beach, then a swim together at Seven Commandos.

plan: Morning Filipino cooking class in El Nido (adobo and kinilaw). In the late afternoon, zipline from the hill above Las Cabanas Beach, then stay for sunset and a swim.
romantic: Sunset and a swim at Las Cabanas Beach.

plan: Morning Taraw Cliff via ferrata: a harnessed climb with a rope bridge and views over Bacuit Bay. Rest at the hotel pool, then spend New Year’s Eve in El Nido town.
romantic: Countdown on a rooftop above El Nido town, with fireworks over Bacuit Bay.

plan: Take a private tricycle north to Nacpan Beach for a swim and lunch at a beach shack. Expect holiday opening hours. Back at the hotel, pack for the 2 Jan flight.
romantic: Toast the new year with fresh coconuts in a hammock at Nacpan.

plan: Land in Naha after the overnight flights, then take the 1-hour domestic flight to Ishigaki and a taxi to the hotel. Easy first evening: walk the Euglena Mall arcade and Yaeyama market area, then dinner of Yaeyama soba and Ishigaki beef. Beach views only, no swim.
romantic: Sunset at Fusaki Beach, facing the west coast, with a walk on the sand and no swim.

plan: Private sightseeing taxi for the north coast: Kabira Bay by glass-bottom boat (stay dry, no swim), Tamatorizaki lookout and Hirakubozaki lighthouse, with a beach stop for views only, no swim.
romantic: Night stargazing tour on Ishigaki, one of Japan’s best dark-sky islands.

plan: Ferry to Taketomi island (10 minutes). Cycle between white-coral lanes and red-tile houses, ride a water-buffalo cart and look for star-shaped sand at Kaiji beach, with no swim.
romantic: Sunset from Nishi pier on Taketomi before the last ferry back.

plan: Guided mangrove kayak on the Nagura river, paddling only, with no swim. Then browse Ishigaki shops for Yaeyama pottery, minsaa weaving and black pearls.
romantic: Dinner at a Yaeyama folk-music izakaya with live sanshin.

plan: Morning flight from Ishigaki to Naha and a monorail ride to the hotel. Walk Tsuboya pottery street and Makishi Public Market, then Okinawa soba for lunch. Swimming is allowed from today, but the sea is only about 22 °C, so Naminoue beach is a quick dip at best.
romantic: Sunset at Naminoue shrine cliff, then dinner of Okinawan food with live sanshin.

plan: Day trip by fast ferry from Tomari port to Zamami island in the Kerama Islands (about 50 minutes). Snorkel with a guide for green sea turtles at Furuzamami beach in a rented wetsuit; the sea is about 22 °C, cool but fine in a wetsuit. Humpback whale season starts around late December, but sightings are not guaranteed.
romantic: Snorkel with sea turtles together, then a quiet sunset on the deck for the ferry home.

plan: Morning karate lesson at a Naha dojo (Okinawa is the birthplace of karate). Free afternoon on Kokusai Street for souvenirs. New Year’s Eve: a toshikoshi soba dinner, then the midnight countdown and first shrine visit (hatsumode) at Naminoue shrine.
romantic: Toshikoshi soba for two, then the midnight countdown at Naminoue shrine on the clifftop.

plan: Late start. Visit Shuri Castle Park and Shikinaen royal garden (check opening, since some places close on 1 Jan), then free time. Pack for the flight home on 2 Jan, with the airport transfer in the morning.
romantic: Sunset at Senagajima Umikaji Terrace beside the airport, watching planes land over the sea.

plan: Land at Beijing Capital after the overnight flight and take the Airport Express and a taxi to the Novotel Beijing Peace near Wangfujing. Cold, about −5 to 3 °C, so wear a down coat, hat and gloves. After a rest, the Forbidden City (book the ticket online a week ahead; closed Mondays) and Jingshan Park for the view over the roofs.
romantic: Sunset over the Forbidden City from Jingshan hill, then Peking duck dinner in Wangfujing.

plan: Universal Beijing Resort all day: Harry Potter, Transformers, Kung Fu Panda and Minion Land. It is about −5 to 3 °C, so dress in layers; Christmas week is busy, so arrive at opening. Metro Line 1 and Line 7 to the Universal Studios line takes about 70 minutes from Wangfujing.
romantic: The castle in the Wizarding World lit up at dusk, with hot chocolate in hand.

plan: Giant pandas first: Beijing Zoo panda house (Metro Line 4, opens 7:30; the pandas are indoors in winter and on view all day, most active at feeding time). Then taxi to the Mutianyu Great Wall: cable car up, walk the watchtowers (steps are icy, wear grip shoes), toboggan down. Cold and windy, about −5 to 3 °C. The wall closes about 17:00, so leave the zoo by 10:00.
romantic: Quiet watchtower walk with the wall winding over the hills.

plan: Morning flight Beijing to Zhangjiajie (about 2 hours 30 minutes), taxi to the Pullman Zhangjiajie. Zhangjiajie can be foggy or icy in late December, about 2 to 10 °C, colder on the peaks; check the cable-car status in the morning. Afternoon at Tianmen Mountain: cable car up, the glass skywalk on the cliff and the Tianmen Cave, back down by sunset (the cable car and skywalk close in strong wind or ice).
romantic: Sunset above the clouds from the Tianmen Mountain cliff walk.

plan: Full day in Zhangjiajie National Forest Park (Wulingyuan): Bailong Elevator, Yuanjiajie’s Avatar Hallelujah Mountain, and the Tianzi Mountain cable car down. The pillars can be fogged in or icy, so wear grip shoes and carry a rain jacket; skip the monkey-heavy Golden Whip Stream. Fog is common; if it clears you see the stone forest, and in fog the pillars appear and vanish.
romantic: Misty stone pillars from the Yuanjiajie viewpoint, with hot tea afterwards.

plan: Morning flight Zhangjiajie to Shanghai (about 2 hours 30 minutes), taxi to the Mercure Shanghai Yuyuan Garden. About 3 to 10 °C. Afternoon at the teamLab slot: teamLab Borderless Shanghai closed in Feb 2024 and teamLab Massless Beijing ended in March 2025, so check teamlab.art in November and swap in an immersive digital art museum in Shanghai if no teamLab is open. Evening on the Bund and a Huangpu river night cruise.
romantic: Walk the Bund at night, with the Pudong skyline across the water.

plan: Shanghai Disneyland all day (Metro Line 11, about 1 hour from the old town; arrive for opening, about 3 to 10 °C, bring layers). Ride Tron, Pirates of the Caribbean and Soaring over the Horizon, and stay for the evening castle fireworks. Metro back and a New Year’s Eve countdown on the Bund or a rooftop bar near Nanjing Road (the Bund can be closed by crowd control, so have the rooftop as plan B).
romantic: Evening fireworks over Enchanted Storybook Castle, then the midnight countdown together.

plan: Slow New Year’s Day: Yu Garden and the old town, a xiaolongbao (soup dumpling) class, then Tianzifang and Xintiandi shopping. Pack for the flight home on 2 Jan (taxi or maglev to Pudong airport on the day, costed here).
romantic: Sunset coffee in Xintiandi on the first evening of the year.

plan: Land at Velana airport and take the Kaani speedboat to Maafushi, about 35 minutes. Rest, then take a short walk through the village lanes and harbour in modest clothes.
romantic: Watch the sunset from Bikini Beach after the long journey.

plan: A beach morning at Bikini Beach, the sandy, shallow swimming area about 40 metres from the hotel. Lunch at a beach café and a slow afternoon.
romantic: Stargazing on the beach after dark, with insect repellent on.

plan: Water sports from the beach with no swimming: a tandem parasail ride plus a jet ski or jet car session with Maafushi Dive. Rest in the afternoon.
romantic: Fly side by side on the tandem parasail.

plan: A slow morning with souvenir shopping in the village. In the late afternoon, the trip’s only boat outing: a dolphin-watching cruise, watching only, no swimming.
romantic: Spot dolphins together from the bow of the boat.

plan: Morning speedboat to the airport and a half-day in Malé: the Old Friday Mosque, Sultan Park, the National Museum and the fish market, with Maldivian short eats for lunch. Afternoon speedboat to Niva Velassaru, 25 minutes.
romantic: Champagne and oysters on the resort beach, a free festive event from 5 to 6 pm.

plan: A wellness day: a couples ritual at the LIME overwater spa, then the Japanese brunch at Sora, the overwater restaurant.
romantic: Cinema Under the Stars, a free outdoor film night at Fen.

plan: A free tennis session in the morning and a quiet afternoon. In the evening, the New Year’s Eve dinner, then the Pure Celestial party on the main beach.
romantic: Count down to midnight barefoot on the sand at the beach party.

plan: Late breakfast, then adopt a coral frame with your names on it through the resort’s marine team. Optional last swim from the sandy main beach before flying home the next day.
romantic: Private candlelit dinner for two in a beach cabana.
